report:
Reviewed the complete checking_scope claim and all ordinary implementation/test entries; there are no TODO/N/A entries. Requirements: request signatures and all supported local bodies, recurse through reachable modules and associated/expanded items, ignore visibility and marker selection when demanding work, avoid eager external body checks, and explicitly fail/diagnose unsupported local work. No entry-point narrowing is offered in v1.

Implementation: observe::collect invokes check_crate(root) before deriving observation targets from markers. check_crate walks the local root; walk_module diagnoses unrecognized syntax and incomplete expansion and walks expanded members; walk_symbol requests local function signatures and bodies, struct signatures/fields, enum signatures, and trait/impl signatures plus associated membership. Its exhaustive external-symbol arms do no work. The local-use association resolves unused import paths and produces unresolved-import errors. parse/mod.rs retains malformed/unsupported enabled items as Error; parse/items.rs preserves function bodies and associated members, recurses into inline/file modules, rejects missing/ambiguous modules, and refuses unsupported associated syntax. associated.rs enumerates each owner CST member into stable symbols without selecting by visibility. The enums CST association now preserves actual ExprCst discriminants and emits their original expression span when reconstructing tokens. The enum walker emits an explicit unsupported diagnostic for each discriminant; this implements the claim's unsupported-work alternative, not general discriminant evaluation. Additional captured reads cover upstream enum signature checking, module expansion/completeness, function query entry points, the macro runner, source-fixture setup, and raw-span rendering.

All eleven associated tests inspected: unselected_private_body_still_reports_errors asserts the same unmarked private-body diagnostic count with and without a type marker; macro_generated_errors_match_the_invocation asserts an expanded function's mismatch; modules_and_associated_bodies checks the completed u16 expression in an impl inside a reachable file module; signature_diagnostics_are_retained_once asserts unresolved signature diagnostics despite two callers; unused_import_is_checked asserts an unused bad import; real_std asserts a clean local function whose signature resolves real external String metadata. External exclusion is supported by that integration plus exhaustive no-op external traversal arms, not a claimed exhaustive query audit of std. malformed_body_is_not_silently_accepted and malformed_private_enum_signature_is_checked now assert a Sage-specific diagnostic failure so independent rustc rejection cannot satisfy them alone. enum_discriminant_body_is_not_silently_accepted accounts for rustc's missing-name diagnostic separately and requires Sage's unsupported diagnostic. valid_enum_discriminant_reports_sage_limitation asserts its exact source location and compiler-qualified limitation while rustc accepts the valid expression. enum_discriminants_survive_syntax_token_rendering parses real source, asserts both discriminants remain present, and asserts the exact reconstructed expression tokens. Together these cover traversal, signatures, marker invariance, malformed source, unsupported work, expansion, external metadata use, and syntax preservation. The future narrower entry-point policy is excluded by the current unconditional root walk and absence of a narrowing option.

Behavioral reproduction and correction: before production edits, cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test review_semantics enum_discriminant_body_is_not_silently_accepted -- --exact failed because Sage accepted enum Hidden { Value = missing() } with only the independent rustc error accounted for. The parser had set discriminant: None and the enum signature query did not inspect discriminants. Preserving expression syntax and emitting an explicit unsupported diagnostic fixes the omission without claiming const evaluation. An initial unqualified version of the experiment caught rustc's error and was therefore insufficient; the preserved regression isolates Sage.

Executed verification: cargo fmt; cargo build passed (existing warnings); cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test review_semantics passed all 8; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test compile_tests passed all 14; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib unselected_private_body_still_reports_errors passed. Source judgment and executed tests are distinct evidence. Fresh review inputs were captured after changes and the complete associated test set was inspected. No remaining edits requested for this anchor.
